meta.title: AeCpt research workbench
meta.description: Connects DeepSeek Harness (DSH) to a self-hosted AeCpt server for the student workbench: overview home, teaching-week progress entries (session fragment collection, one-click AI report compilation, and supervisor feedback), personal plans and sharing, local RSS/Atom/arXiv literature subscriptions, and the research group's shared paper library (DOI/arXiv submission, search, PDF download, BibTeX export). Credentials live in the DSH credential store.
